strongest_rejected_alternative: A reviewer could still keep 31:18 attached forward to the golden-calf narrative as its dramatic-irony setup; that reading was the original one and is not without merit, and without any named colophon-family match the case for reading 31:18 backward rests on ordinary syntax alone.
